description: Docket's sidebar: an inbox-row hover card, rows with the thin arc while work runs, an Inbox at the top with only the chats that want you, and the chat's folder, branch and agent as Properties in Session Info.

scopes.workspace:read: Name the rows to decorate, and mark the open chat in the inbox.
scopes.agent_chat:read: List the chats that want you in the inbox: title, state and age.
scopes.workspace:write: Show a chat's workspace when you click it in the inbox.
